name: Steelborn VR
summary: Steelborn VR puts you in the heart of intense close combat. Use your sword and shield to fend off relentless waves of enemies coming from all sides. Time your strikes, block incoming attacks, and unleash your power to survive. Customize your experience by choosing your own background music directly from the menu — fight to your rhythm, sharpen your reflexes, and prove that you are truly Steelborn!
